props._notes:
The page's playful line is the headline itself, so the .smile
           italic rides the h2 size (§6.4).

Rebuilt 2026-09-22. It had offered five links, two of them under names
         the site stopped using: "The Music" (the roster is Artist Roster in
         the nav row and the footer) and "Corporate & Galas" (retired in the
         17 Aug audit, when galas became a section of the corporate hub rather
         than a co-headline). It also offered no way into Weddings, Private
         Parties or Daytime — three of the four occasion trees. It now carries
         what the footer carries, in the same words, plus the full index.
         Labels match the nav row character for character; scripts/nav_lint.py
         reads this list along with the header and the footer.
